parquet:columns.unique_id: Unique identifier of the lightning cluster (orbit_frame + source + cluster_id)
parquet:columns.orbit_frame: Orbit/frame identifier of the EarthCARE overpass
parquet:columns.source: Lightning data source: LI (MTG) or GLM (GOES)
parquet:columns.surface_type: Surface classification at cluster location (land, water, coast)
parquet:columns.peak_datetime: Time of CPR sample with maximum lightning activity
parquet:columns.peak_lat: Latitude of CPR sample with maximum lightning activity
parquet:columns.peak_lon: Longitude of CPR sample with maximum lightning activity
parquet:columns.peak_lightning: Maximum lightning group count at a CPR sample
parquet:columns.nadir_lightning: Lightning group count within ±2.5 min and ±2.5 km of CPR nadir track
parquet:columns.cluster_lightning: Lightning group count within ±2.5 min of CPR peak time (any distance)
parquet:columns.cluster_mean_lat: Mean latitude of lightning groups within ±2.5 min of CPR peak time
parquet:columns.cluster_mean_lon: Mean longitude of lightning groups within ±2.5 min of CPR peak time
parquet:columns.cluster_dist_km: Minimum distance (km) between CPR track and mean cluster location
parquet:columns.first_lightning_min: Minute offset of first lightning in parent cluster relative to peak_datetime
parquet:columns.last_lightning_min: Minute offset of last lightning in parent cluster relative to peak_datetime
parquet:columns.travel_km: Shortest distance (km) between first and last lightning locations in parent cluster
parquet:columns.missing_peak_minutes: Total minutes of missing data overlapping ±2.5 min around peak_datetime
parquet:columns.masked_minute_counts: Lightning group counts per minute (–60…+60) with missing intervals masked as null
